name: Media Studio
note: The three Node surfaces are ONE process now (node-services.mjs on 8793, mounted at /canvas, /bridge and /agent). 8788, 8794 and 8796 still answer as compatibility ports, so every entrypoint below stays true; new readers should prefer nodeServices and its /healthz, which is the only endpoint that knows whether all three surfaces came up. The /canvas mount is for API and proxy routes only: every page behind it emits absolute asset URLs and the mount does not rewrite bodies, so a browser addresses the Canvas on 8788 (a navigation to /canvas is redirected there). /bridge has no such limit.

components.name: Studio Node Services
components.role: one Node process hosting the Canvas surface, the local-inference bridge and the agent MCP

components.role: Next.js shell, ComfyUI proxy, model manager, mobile route wrapper

components.role: generation API, history, encrypted output serving, workflow recovery
